name: cloud_providers
summary: The single source of truth for 'what providers exist' and their cost/latency/tier/family metadata. 15 ProviderSpec rows: 3 DeepSeek variants (chat/coder/reasoner), 7 HF router providers (groq, cerebras, fireworks-ai, together, novita, deepinfra, hf-inference), 1 ZeroGPU placeholder, 1 DO droplet placeholder, 1 browser-WebGPU placeholder, 1 local Ollama, 1 HF Inference Endpoint placeholder. Each spec carries kind, endpoint, key_env, cost_per_million_in/out, max_context, rate_limit_per_minute, tier (free|cheap|fast|premium), priority_speed/cost, families, supports_streaming. Convenience lookups: get(), list_by_tier/family/kind, list_active (checks env presence), pick() (v1 ranked fallback ladder; router_policy will subsume in Phase 1).
engine_pattern: Pure-data module — immutable PROVIDERS tuple of frozen ProviderSpec dataclasses. is_active property checks studio/auth/keys.load_env for the provider's key_env. No DB; rebuilt on import. CLI subcommands: list, active, get <name>, pick --family --cost-class --latency-budget-ms, stats.

kinds_vocabulary.openai_compat: direct OpenAI-shape REST (DeepSeek today; could expand)
kinds_vocabulary.browser_ws: chromium WebGPU worker via weave fabric (placeholder)
kinds_vocabulary.droplet_http: DO droplet remote dispatch over WireGuard (placeholder)

substrate: in-memory tuple; cli prints JSON. No persistence beyond source code.

inbound_callers: core/lib/model_api.py (reads PROVIDERS, calls pick per request)
core/lib/router_policy.py (Phase 1 #57 — subsumes pick with full decision tree)
routing_connections.substrate_reads: .env via keys.load_env to mark providers active

pick_v1_logic: Tier-aware ranking: cost_class='free|cheap' prefers (free, cheap, fast, premium) order with secondary sort on -priority_cost; cost_class='fast' prefers fast tier exclusively (returns only fast-tier providers) when latency_budget_ms <= 800; otherwise blends. Caps fallback at 4 attempts to avoid runaway. Use must_run_local=True for sensitive prompts.
guarantees: Single source of truth — no provider list duplicated elsewhere
Immutable specs — frozen dataclasses prevent runtime drift
Auth-aware — is_active reflects current .env state without imports of secrets
Replaceable pick() — router_policy can swap in without breaking ModelAPI
OpenAI-compat shape preserved — kind='openai_compat' specs all use /v1/chat/completions
phase: D.7 of lively-enchanting-parrot plan (promoted from #57 Phase 1)
